stage_release: Future stage arrays are not decompressed before activate(stage). Initial learning sees initial old normal only.
normal_verifier: Ground-truth-assisted verified-normal environment; actual attack rows excluded from all clean weight and reference fitting
threshold: Frozen no-update retains initial old q95. Calibration-only and all updates use max(old q95,current-stage new q95). Same-threshold controls separate calibration from weight adaptation.
selection_score: -0.5*(log(old normal MSE + 1e-12)+log(new normal MSE + 1e-12)); no attack-label metric enters selection
guard: Old normal reconstruction MSE <= initial*1.05; old/new normal FPR <= recalibrated_previous+.02; normal score improves >1e-4. Attack AUC/TPR logged for monitoring only.
trigger: If verified candidate normal FPR under the previous deployed detector <=0.10, skip weight/ref training but update normal calibration
upstream: Same SAE topology hidden50/latent11 and MSEAvg; schema-sized input/output; shared sequential semantics; original two-if global stop; norm versus explicit squared loss is a controlled recipe factor
privacy: Dataset experiments; initial old/server development/validation materials are shared assumptions. No DP or privacy guarantee
coverage: N-BaIoT has 9 actual devices and 7 Mirai-covered clients. RT uses 5 virtual clients, not claimed physical hosts. File order is not proven timestamps.
